records.owner: zlc_plugin SDK (commit_live, commit_events); native scan (zlc-workbench scan/execution.rs)
records.purpose: each output's event record, by output name

shot_time_seconds.purpose: when each output's shot was taken (s); the host stamps it on the publication (its shot time)

operation.owner: desktop: plot ROI and fit (zlc-plot document), Figure import (archive.rs), manual data (main.rs)
operation.purpose: which desktop operation made the event
operation.unread: no reader; the same value is the run's record (derivation.rs, archive.rs, main.rs begin the run with it). Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

subject.unread: no reader; equal to the run record. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

selector.unread: no reader; equal to the run record. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

fit.unread: no reader; equal to the run record. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

frames_missing.purpose: the slots of a shot whose frames never came, written only for such a shot: why its data is invalid

device_settings.owner: camera_measurement and its subclasses (camera/measurement.py _camera_event_record); calibration capture preview (calibration/outputs.py)
device_settings.purpose: the camera settings epoch the frames were taken in (device session, epoch ranges, mixed)

actual_devices.owner: native scan (zlc-workbench scan/execution.rs, read back by scan/seamless.py); calibration site review (calibration/outputs.py, the run record)
actual_devices.purpose: the device readbacks at this scan point

device_snapshots.purpose: the devices as they stood for this event (the SLM's command and mapping revisions)

image_point_overlay_geometry.owner: slm_feedback camera frames; slm_rearrangement; calibration site review
image_point_overlay_geometry.purpose: the sites drawn over the image (coordinates, ids, labels, status axis)

rearrangement.purpose: one cycle's rearrangement evidence (indices, timing, gate misses, ratios)
rearrangement.unread: no reader. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

capture_events.purpose: each output's capture device snapshots and source ordinal
capture_events.unread: no reader; the Devices tab does not see its nested snapshots. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

device_snapshot_context.purpose: which candidate the device snapshots belong to, and whether its measurement completed
device_snapshot_context.unread: no reader. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

record_timing.purpose: each event's record and source times, time basis and arrival
record_timing.unread: no reader; its record time repeats shot_time_seconds and its keys the publication's owner and ordinal. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

request.owner: calibration site review (calibration/outputs.py, the run record)
request.unread: no reader; the event record repeats the whole run record. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).

pulse.owner: calibration site review (calibration/outputs.py, the run record)
pulse.unread: no reader of the event's copy (the Figure record reads the run record's); the event record repeats the whole run record. Awaiting the user's decision (2026-11-21).
